base.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
base.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.

flags.text: Operating margin expanding: 15.0% (3y avg) vs 12.7% before

Latest quarter revenue YoY +4.5% vs +29.5% avg of prior 3 — slowdown
Heavy capex underway: CWIP is 34% of fixed assets

Cash after investing negative in 5 of last 5 years — growth is funded externally

bull: Annual revenue grew at 33.2% in FY26 to INR 3,626 Cr and 3-year sales CAGR stands at +47.7%.
Operating profit margin held steady between 13% and 17% across quarters from Sep 2023 to Sep 2026.
Net worth expanded to INR 4,935 Cr in Sep 2026 from INR 959 Cr in Mar 2023.
bear: CFO severely deteriorated to negative INR 600 Cr in FY26, down from negative INR 82 Cr in FY25.
Borrowings climbed to INR 1,986 Cr in Sep 2026, while debtor days stretched from 74 to 154 days.
PAT in Sep 2026 dropped 65.5% YoY to INR 40 Cr as revenue growth decelerated to 4.5% YoY.
